description: Synthetic sesslint.assessment parity: cap validation, regular-file check_impl seam, and SourceAssessment.unchanged SHA-256 probes.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-assessment-check-impl: assess_source on a regular file runs sesslint.api._check_impl in Python and returns SourceAssessment. Rust stops at CheckImpl and does not build Report or events.
GAP-assessment-missing-path-message: a missing path raises OSError text from CPython; Rust returns std::io::Error display.
GAP-assessment-identity-dev-ino: st_dev and st_ino are 0 on non-Unix Rust ports without unstable metadata APIs.
GAP-assessment-io-default: DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES is duplicated in Rust from the pin io.py blob; this crate does not depend on an io crate.
